canAcknowledge.description: Whether it repeats until a person acknowledges it: an urgent alarm.

paused.description: Why it is paused, when it is.

values.description: The new values, by field id.

charter.description: The charter under review, if a draft exists.

kind.description: The site kind's template it started from.

notice.description: What the site says before the first connection (A-I19).

default.description: What applies until the owner decides.

canGoLive.description: Whether the owner can go live now.

cost.description: The monthly running-cost estimate, by category.

fits.description: Whether the estimate fits the budget.

waiting.description: The launch waiting for its approval chain.

options.description: The directions, and keeping the current design for an existing site.

approval.description: The approval chain it waits for.

changes.description: The live item it changes, if any.

fields.description: The kind's fields with their values.

preview.description: The preview's pages and how they change.

language.description: Its language; the site's first unless set.

Saves the draft's form and runs the per-change checks.

EditorHome.description: The editor's home: the forms, the content and the drafts (spec 3.5 §7.8.2).

chain.description: Who approves a publication, when the charter names a chain.

items.description: The site's content, newest kinds first.

open.description: Whether the owner may still answer it.

status.description: "A guess" until the owner confirms it.

oneOf.description: Markdown, with the editor's formatting buttons and preview (spec 3.5 §13 Q13).

required.description: Whether it must be filled in.

fields.description: Its fields, with the answers given.

fromDiscovery.description: Whether discovery's confirmed facts answered it already.

GateView.description: Stage 7: the launch gate's report, page by page (spec 3.5 §7.8.1, §7.18).

HeldDecision.description: The owner's decision on something held.

HeldDeliveryLine.description: A feed delivery held whole (spec 3.5 A-I27).

HeldPayment.description: A payment held for the owner (spec 3.5 §7.14).

ItemLine.description: One item of the site's content.

live.description: Whether it can be corrected or withdrawn: it is live.

scheduled.description: When it publishes, for a scheduled item.

canLower.description: Whether the viewer may lower it.

canPromote.description: Whether the viewer may raise it.

next.description: The level a promotion would give it.

offered.description: Whether it has earned the offer of a promotion.

Line.description: A label and its value, for a card's lines.

results.description: Revenue, profit, cost per lead and per sale, where the site sells.

within.description: Whether the month is inside the budget.

to.description: The level a promotion gives it.

next.description: The next step of a connection, for the person to take outside the site.

current.description: The stage to do now; `done` once the site runs.

protect.description: Stage 3, for a site on a legacy runtime.

about.description: The About page as built, in Markdown.

facts.description: How many confirmed facts it shows.

published.description: Whether the preview is on the host.

otherFiles.description: How many other files it changed.

alarms.description: Alarms that waited for the review.

kpis.description: KPIs against baselines and targets, with trends.

sent.description: Where and when its summary went.

promotions.description: The levels the jobs can earn, offered for your decision.

holding.description: What visitors see until the site is launched.
